newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 22.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 22. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bank Indonesia Governor Soedradjad Djiwandono has asked the people not to quickly panic and buy dollars in reaction to the sharp drop in the value of the rupiah.
The Salim group has denied its selling of shares of PT Indofood Sukes Makmur to Singapore-based company QAF Ltd is a case of capital flight.
Indonesian Foreign Minister said Cambodia's admission at this week's annual ASEAN ministerial meeting was impossible but it would retain observer status with the group.
Despite Indonesia's strong economic fundamentals, speculators made more concerted attacks on the rupiah pushing it to a record low and prompting the central bank to intervene to defend the currency.

State-owned oil company Pertamina has been criticised by legislators for allowing privately owned Sempati Air to fall behind in paying its debts for procurement of aviation fuel when it had stopped supplying diesel to state power utility PLN for not paying bills on time.
The Jakarta share index underwent a 1.6 percent correction falling to 712.402 points as a result of a sharp fall in the value of the rupiah.

Sitting legislator Aberson Sihaloho from the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) has been sentenced to nine months jail for defaming the president during a speech given at a rally in Jakarta in July 1996.
